responses_en:
It’s normal to feel stressed when exams and deadlines pile up. Let’s start with a few manageable steps:
• List your upcoming exams, projects, and deadlines.
• Prioritize tasks according to urgency and importance.
• Break large tasks into smaller, achievable steps.
• Study in focused intervals and take short breaks.
• Get enough sleep, eat regularly, and allow time to rest.

If your stress feels overwhelming or is affecting your daily functioning, you may reach out to the Guidance and Counseling office for additional support.

Information shared during a consultation is handled according to the school’s confidentiality policies. If you have concerns about privacy or documentation, you may ask the GCO about its procedure before your consultation.

The Guidance and Counseling Office (GCO) is located on the 2nd floor of STI College Sta. Maria, beside the School Administration Office and the Human Resources (HR) Office. responses_en:
Your privacy is important to the Guidance and Counseling Office. Information shared during a consultation is handled with care and according to applicable privacy requirements and school policies.

However, confidentiality may have limits. Information may need to be shared with appropriate people when there is a serious risk of harm to you or someone else, a safeguarding concern, or another applicable legal or institutional requirement.

When appropriate and safe, the GCO will explain the reason for sharing information and involve you in the process.

responses_en:
A student may be referred to the GCO by a faculty member, school staff member, parent or guardian, or another appropriate person. Students may also seek help directly.

After a referral, the GCO may:
• Review the concern and the information provided.
• Determine the urgency of the situation and the appropriate next steps.
• Contact the student and arrange an initial conversation or consultation.
• Discuss appropriate support, possible follow-up, or referral to another qualified professional or service if needed.

Referrals are handled with care and according to applicable privacy, safeguarding, and school policies. Urgent safety concerns should be addressed immediately rather than waiting for routine referral processing.

responses_en:
If you are concerned about a student's behavior, emotional well-being, attendance, academic performance, or safety, please refer the concern to the GCO through the school's approved procedure.

When raising the concern, provide factual observations, relevant dates, and any immediate safety issues. Avoid making diagnoses or sharing sensitive information with people who do not need to know.

If the student appears to be in immediate danger or may harm themselves or someone else, do not wait for a routine referral. Follow the school's emergency procedures and seek immediate assistance.

responses_en:
The GCO is generally available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with a lunch break from 12:00 PM–1:00 PM. If you need urgent help outside these hours, please do not wait for the office to reopen.

If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department.

For mental health crisis support in the Philippines, contact the National Center for Mental Health Crisis Hotline at 1553. Other published contact numbers include 0917-899-8727 and 0919-057-1553.

If possible, reach out to a trusted adult, family member, or another person who can stay with you and help you access support.

You may also email the GCO at eslie.clemente@stamaria.sti.edu.ph. Messages sent outside office hours may not receive an immediate response.

responses_en:
The Guidance and Counseling Office (GCO) offers these services to students:
• Consultation: one-on-one sessions for personal, academic, social, or emotional concerns.
• Referral: connecting you to the right support when a concern needs more help.
• Career Guidance: help with choosing a strand, course, or career, including the Career Planning Program for Senior High School.
• Group Guidance: sessions on topics students need, based on needs assessments.
• Information Service: announcements and guidance resources.
• Individual Inventory: your guidance record and submitted documents.
• Testing Service.
You can talk about personal concerns, not only school-related ones. To start, book a session under My Appointments, or ask me a question.
responses_tl:
Ito ang mga serbisyo ng Guidance and Counseling Office (GCO) para sa mga estudyante:
• Consultation: one-on-one na usapan tungkol sa personal, academic, social, o emotional na concern.
• Referral: pagkonekta sa iyo sa tamang tulong kapag kailangan ng mas malalim na suporta.
• Career Guidance: tulong sa pagpili ng strand, course, o career, kasama ang Career Planning Program para sa Senior High School.
• Group Guidance: mga session sa mga paksang kailangan ng mga estudyante, batay sa needs assessment.
• Information Service: mga anunsyo at guidance resources.
• Individual Inventory: ang iyong guidance record at mga isinumiteng dokumento.
• Testing Service.
Puwede kang magsabi ng personal na concern, hindi lang tungkol sa school. Para magsimula, mag-book ng session sa My Appointments, o magtanong sa akin.
